text: AI is changing how we create art, music, and writing. Today, computers can generate paintings, compose songs, and even write stories. Some people are excited about this, while others have doubts. Can a machine truly be creative, or is it just copying what humans have done before? Human creativity comes from emotions, experiences, and imagination. AI, on the other hand, learns from large amounts of data and produces results based on patterns. Perhaps the best approach is to see AI as a helpful tool rather than a replacement. Artists and writers can use it to find new ideas and work faster, but the heart of creativity still belongs to people.
